scope:
Export exact synthetic development PCM and its verified Hi ESP baseline.

Only the plan-bound paired scope is exported. Excluded acoustic controls are
not opened. Paths become relative; source WAV bytes and numeric results stay
unchanged. No microphone recording, account/device state or feature arrays.
limits: Previously scored synthetic development fixtures, not independent final acceptance or human speaker trials.
Variant0 and variant3 are correlated existing normal-speed renderings. Keep their original bytes and source-voice grouping.
Hi ESP was measured by a standalone development-P4 direct-PCM probe. Numeric timing is not whole-application CPU or microphone/AEC acceptance.
Keyword endpoints are synthesis/RMS estimates, not phonetic ground truth. Keep any-event recall separate from the fixed estimated-end window.
Near-word distributions are phrase-specific; report shared ordinary sentences and Nyx-specific and ESP-specific groups separately. ESP near-word pronunciation retains uncertainty.
Two previous acoustic fixture controls outside this paired population are excluded and not opened. Account/device/UART state is never exported.

portable_baseline_summary.scope: Paired Mac synthetic development regression, not acoustic acceptance.
limits: Synthetic variants of one source phrase are correlated; these are not independent human trials.
Keyword endpoints are RMS estimates, not phonetic alignment. Report any-event and fixed-window recall separately.
The phrase-specific negative texts differ; do not equate the two near-word distributions.
Mac pronunciation diagnostics are imperfect. Older bare ESP samples were rejected for abbreviation expansion.
No long continuous-negative, real-user, microphone/AEC or full-app load acceptance is established here.
